canonical_source.behavior: From the loaded Site Details workspace, the Settings control navigates to the selected site's settings while retaining the exact current site identity.

laravel_adaptation.adaptation_reason: Laravel preserves the canonical Settings navigation intent inside its tenant-scoped SPA: the current positive site route identifier is encoded into the Settings selector while the active tenant slug comes only from trusted frontend context.

authorization.frontend_visibility: requires tenant.view and sites.view, or wildcard permission
authorization.missing_permission_semantics: 403 on the protected Site Details source route

tenant_isolation.proof: The target tenant slug is derived only from authoritative frontend context, malformed/non-positive site route identifiers fail closed, foreign site selectors are hidden by tenant-scoped context lookup, and foreign tenant namespaces fail membership resolution as 404 before route permissions run.
tenant_isolation.caller_override_probe: Route identifiers containing traversal/query syntax are rejected and the control cannot accept a caller-supplied tenant override.

coverage: exact canonical operation identity and source metadata
same-tenant Settings boot with selected site
authoritative tenant context resolves the selected site
sites.view denial on the protected source route
tenant-scoped Settings href with current site pinned

terminality.basis: The canonical Site Details Settings navigation is implemented as a real Laravel control bound to trusted tenant context and the current site route, with deterministic frontend/PHP coverage for permission, malformed identifier, and cross-tenant fail-closed behavior and no fabricated external evidence.
